decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in
accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans
submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, Flood Risk Assessment,
5050-002C (Proposed Site Plan), 5050-004D (Proposed Plan), 5050-005C
(Proposed Elevations), 5050-006A (Proposed Roof Plan), 09A (Air Hall
Screening Proposal), Travel Plan, Energy Statement, Airhall Lighting
Specification, Sustainability Checklist, Transport Statement; all received 27
April 2011; and Phase 1 Desk Study, received 5 August 2011) and approved
by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in
writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 2 - The temporary dome hereby approved shall only be used for playing
indoor tennis and tennis coaching, ancillary to the outdoor recreational use of
the site, and shall only be erected from 15 October until 15 April and not
erected at any other time of the year.

Condition : 3 - Twenty secure cycle parking spaces shall be provided on the site within 3
months of this permission, and thereafter retained and made available to the
users and staff at the site.

Condition : 4 - Seven marked disabled car parking spaces shall be provided on the site
within 3 months of this permission, and thereafter retained and made
available to the users and staff at the site.

Condition : 5 - All landscape works, including tree and shrub planting, shall be carried out
in accordance with drawing 09A (Air Hall Screening Proposal) received 27
April 2011. The works shall be completed by the end of the first tree planting
season from the date of this permission (the first planting season being from
November 2011 to March 2012) or in accordance with a programme agreed in
writing with the local planning authority.

Condition : 6 - If within a period of one year from the date of the planting of any tree, that
tree, or any tree planted in replacement for it, is removed, uprooted or
destroyed or dies, (or becomes, in the opinion of the local planning authority,
seriously damaged or defective,) another tree of the same species and size
as that originally planted shall be planted at the same place, unless the local
planning authority gives its written consent to any variation.

Condition : 7 - In this condition "retained tree" means an existing tree which is to be
retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars; and
paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of (5 years?)
from (the date of the occupation of the building for its permitted use).
(a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall
any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the
approved plans and particulars, without the written approval of the local
planning authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in
accordance with British Standard[3998 (Tree Work)] or any other BS
replacing.
(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another
tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and
species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by
the local planning authority.
(c) The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree shall be
undertaken in accordance with the approved plans and particulars before any
equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes
of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery
and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be
stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition and the
ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation
be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.

Condition : 8 - The portable floodlights within the temporary dome shall only be used
between 15 October and 15 April and shall accord with the details
of the ?Airhall Lighting Specification? dated April 2011, received 27 April 2011.
The floodlighting, hereby permitted, shall not be operated outside the hours of
7:00am to 10:00pm. Details of a system that turns these floodlights off
automatically at 10:00pm shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
Local Planning Authority, and the details shall be implemented as approved,
prior to the first re-erection of the temporary dome (prior to 15 October 2012).

Condition : 9 - Access to the premises by people with disabilities and facilities (including
toilets and parking spaces) shall be provided for them in accordance Sport
England?s Design Guidance Note ?Accessible Sports Facilities? 2010, with
details to be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning
Authority, and the details shall be implemented as approved, prior to the first
re-erection of the temporary dome (prior to 15 October 2012).
description: Retrospective planning permission for the reinstatement of nine tennis courts with associated fencing, surfacing and floodlighting and the seasonal erection of a demountable, air cushioned, dome over five tennis courts
